G1.evidence: Pennsylvania does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania on the discipline of members of the Pennsylvania bar, prosecuted by its Disciplinary Board, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 2173 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania on the discipline of members of the Pennsylvania bar, prosecuted by its Disciplinary Board, 1976 to 2019. 2 of them share a surname with a disciplined attorney and were read against the text of those decisions, which name somebody else. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 2 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Pennsylvania publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 43 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 45 public client reviews across 2 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2005-05-10, so it has been operating for more than a year
